use serde::Serialize;
use std::hint::black_box;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool;
use std::time::Instant;
use te1_chess::{
    START_FEN, SearchPosition, Te1Game, fide_position_hash, is_capture, parse_board,
    parse_legal_uci_move,
};
use te1_search::{SearchLimits, SearchOptions, search};
use te1_tt::TranspositionTable;

const SAMPLES: usize = 7;
const ITERATIONS: u64 = 50_000;
const WARMUP_ITERATIONS: u64 = 5_000;
const SEARCH_DEPTH: u8 = 7;
const LEGAL_HISTORY_CONTEXT_DOMAIN: u64 = 0x243f_6a88_85a3_08d3;
const SYNTHETIC_NULL_HISTORY_CONTEXT_DOMAIN: u64 = 0x1319_8a2e_0370_7344;
const HISTORY_CONTEXT_GOLDEN: u64 = 0x9e37_79b9_7f4a_7c15;

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
struct SpanRow {
    reversible_span: u16,
    full_make_unmake_ns: f64,
    board_snapshot_play_hash_ns: f64,
    history_scan_model_ns: f64,
    full_over_board_ratio: f64,
    full_share_of_search_node: f64,
    non_board_excess_share_of_search_node: f64,
    history_scan_share_of_search_node: f64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
struct SearchRow {
    label: String,
    median_ns_per_node: f64,
    median_nodes: u64,
    depth: u8,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
struct Summary {
    schema: &'static str,
    production_commit: &'static str,
    production_search_blob: &'static str,
    production_search_sha256: &'static str,
    samples: usize,
    iterations_per_sample: u64,
    search_depth: u8,
    search_profile: &'static str,
    search_reference_median_ns_per_node: f64,
    span_rows: Vec<SpanRow>,
    search_rows: Vec<SearchRow>,
    representative_span: u16,
    representative_full_share: f64,
    representative_non_board_excess_share: f64,
    representative_history_scan_share: f64,
    classification: &'static str,
}

fn history_context_mix(state: u64, value: u64) -> u64 {
    let mut mixed = state ^ value.wrapping_add(HISTORY_CONTEXT_GOLDEN).rotate_left(17);
    mixed ^= mixed >> 30;
    mixed = mixed.wrapping_mul(0xbf58_476d_1ce4_e5b9);
    mixed ^= mixed >> 27;
    mixed = mixed.wrapping_mul(0x94d0_49bb_1331_11eb);
    mixed ^ (mixed >> 31)
}

fn compute_history_context_model(keys: &[u64], halfmove_clock: u16, repetition_start: usize) -> u64 {
    let len = keys.len();
    let reversible_span = usize::from(halfmove_clock).saturating_add(1);
    let rule50_start = len.saturating_sub(reversible_span);
    let start = repetition_start.max(rule50_start).min(len);
    let synthetic_null_domain = repetition_start > rule50_start;
    let mut context = if synthetic_null_domain {
        SYNTHETIC_NULL_HISTORY_CONTEXT_DOMAIN
    } else {
        LEGAL_HISTORY_CONTEXT_DOMAIN
    };
    let window = &keys[start..];
    context = history_context_mix(context, u64::try_from(window.len()).unwrap_or(u64::MAX));
    for (index, key) in window.iter().copied().enumerate() {
        context = history_context_mix(context, key);
        context = history_context_mix(context, u64::try_from(index).unwrap_or(u64::MAX));
    }
    context
}

fn count_current_repetitions_model(keys: &[u64], halfmove_clock: u16) -> u8 {
    let Some(&current) = keys.last() else {
        return 0;
    };
    let reversible = usize::from(halfmove_clock).saturating_add(1);
    let count = keys
        .iter()
        .rev()
        .take(reversible)
        .filter(|&&key| key == current)
        .count();
    u8::try_from(count).unwrap_or(u8::MAX)
}

fn median(mut values: Vec<f64>) -> f64 {
    values.sort_by(f64::total_cmp);
    let middle = values.len() / 2;
    if values.len() % 2 == 0 {
        (values[middle - 1] + values[middle]) / 2.0
    } else {
        values[middle]
    }
}

fn median_u64(mut values: Vec<u64>) -> u64 {
    values.sort_unstable();
    values[values.len() / 2]
}

fn median_ns_per_op<F>(mut operation: F) -> f64
where
    F: FnMut() -> u64,
{
    let mut warmup_checksum = 0u64;
    for _ in 0..WARMUP_ITERATIONS {
        warmup_checksum = warmup_checksum.rotate_left(1) ^ operation();
    }
    black_box(warmup_checksum);

    let mut samples = Vec::with_capacity(SAMPLES);
    let mut checksum = 0u64;
    for _ in 0..SAMPLES {
        let start = Instant::now();
        for _ in 0..ITERATIONS {
            checksum = checksum.rotate_left(1) ^ operation();
        }
        let elapsed = start.elapsed().as_nanos() as f64;
        samples.push(elapsed / ITERATIONS as f64);
    }
    black_box(checksum);
    median(samples)
}

fn reversible_history(span: u16) -> Vec<String> {
    (0..=span)
        .map(|clock| {
            format!(
                "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - {clock} 1"
            )
        })
        .collect()
}

fn profile_span(span: u16, search_reference_ns_per_node: f64) -> SpanRow {
    let history = reversible_history(span);
    let game = Te1Game::from_history(&history).expect("synthetic reversible history must parse");
    let mv = parse_legal_uci_move(game.board(), "g1f3").expect("g1f3 must be legal");

    let mut position = SearchPosition::from_game(&game);
    let full_make_unmake_ns = median_ns_per_op(|| {
        let undo = position.make_move(mv);
        let digest = position.search_key()
            ^ position.history_context()
            ^ u64::try_from(position.repetition_count()).unwrap_or(u64::MAX);
        position.unmake_move(undo);
        digest
    });

    let mut board = game.board().clone();
    let board_snapshot_play_hash_ns = median_ns_per_op(|| {
        let moving = board.piece_on(mv.from).map_or(0, |piece| piece as u64);
        let capture = is_capture(&board, mv);
        let undo = board.clone();
        board.play_unchecked(mv);
        let hash = fide_position_hash(&board);
        board = undo;
        hash ^ moving ^ if capture { 1 } else { 0 }
    });

    let mut keys = history
        .iter()
        .map(|fen| fide_position_hash(&parse_board(fen).expect("profile FEN must parse")))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let mut after = game.board().clone();
    after.play_unchecked(mv);
    keys.push(fide_position_hash(&after));
    let child_halfmove = span.saturating_add(1);
    let history_scan_model_ns = median_ns_per_op(|| {
        let keys = black_box(keys.as_slice());
        let repetitions = count_current_repetitions_model(keys, child_halfmove);
        let context = compute_history_context_model(keys, child_halfmove, 0);
        context ^ u64::from(repetitions)
    });

    let non_board_excess = (full_make_unmake_ns - board_snapshot_play_hash_ns).max(0.0);
    SpanRow {
        reversible_span: span,
        full_make_unmake_ns,
        board_snapshot_play_hash_ns,
        history_scan_model_ns,
        full_over_board_ratio: full_make_unmake_ns / board_snapshot_play_hash_ns.max(1.0),
        full_share_of_search_node: full_make_unmake_ns / search_reference_ns_per_node,
        non_board_excess_share_of_search_node: non_board_excess / search_reference_ns_per_node,
        history_scan_share_of_search_node: history_scan_model_ns / search_reference_ns_per_node,
    }
}

fn game_from_moves(moves: &[&str]) -> Te1Game {
    let mut game = Te1Game::from_fen(START_FEN).expect("start position must parse");
    for mv in moves {
        game.play_uci(mv).expect("frozen benchmark move must be legal");
    }
    game
}

fn profile_search(label: &str, game: &Te1Game) -> SearchRow {
    let mut ns_per_node = Vec::with_capacity(3);
    let mut node_samples = Vec::with_capacity(3);
    for _ in 0..3 {
        let table = Arc::new(TranspositionTable::with_megabytes(64));
        let start = Instant::now();
        let result = search(
            game,
            SearchLimits {
                depth: Some(SEARCH_DEPTH),
                ..SearchLimits::default()
            },
            Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),
            table,
            SearchOptions {
                use_null_move_pruning: true,
                ..SearchOptions::default()
            },
        )
        .expect("fixed-depth production-profile search must succeed");
        let elapsed_ns = start.elapsed().as_nanos() as f64;
        assert!(!result.stopped, "depth-only search unexpectedly stopped");
        assert_eq!(result.depth, SEARCH_DEPTH, "search did not complete frozen depth");
        assert!(result.nodes > 0, "search reported zero nodes");
        ns_per_node.push(elapsed_ns / result.nodes as f64);
        node_samples.push(result.nodes);
    }
    SearchRow {
        label: label.to_owned(),
        median_ns_per_node: median(ns_per_node),
        median_nodes: median_u64(node_samples),
        depth: SEARCH_DEPTH,
    }
}

fn main() {
    let search_games = [
        ("start", game_from_moves(&[])),
        (
            "ruy_lopez",
            game_from_moves(&[
                "e2e4", "e7e5", "g1f3", "b8c6", "f1b5", "a7a6", "b5a4", "g8f6",
                "e1g1", "f8e7",
            ]),
        ),
        (
            "queens_gambit",
            game_from_moves(&[
                "d2d4", "d7d5", "c2c4", "e7e6", "b1c3", "g8f6", "c1g5", "f8e7",
                "e2e3", "e8g8",
            ]),
        ),
    ];

    let search_rows = search_games
        .iter()
        .map(|(label, game)| profile_search(label, game))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let search_reference_median_ns_per_node = median(
        search_rows
            .iter()
            .map(|row| row.median_ns_per_node)
            .collect(),
    );

    let span_rows = [0u16, 16, 32, 64, 96]
        .into_iter()
        .map(|span| profile_span(span, search_reference_median_ns_per_node))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let representative = span_rows
        .iter()
        .find(|row| row.reversible_span == 64)
        .expect("span 64 row must exist");

    let classification = if representative.full_share_of_search_node >= 0.20
        && representative.non_board_excess_share_of_search_node >= 0.10
    {
        "HIGH_MATERIAL"
    } else if representative.full_share_of_search_node >= 0.10
        && representative.non_board_excess_share_of_search_node >= 0.05
    {
        "MATERIAL"
    } else {
        "MINOR_OR_UNPROVEN"
    };

    let summary = Summary {
        schema: "TE1-ALPHA26-SEARCH-POSITION-HOTPATH-R1-v1",
        production_commit: "1b367019ee83c91fc25fabfbf11af3f3218b4a56",
        production_search_blob: "94a099411923ab690a80ebfef1c277a1d44ad934",
        production_search_sha256: "b577f71bd09319c5c62fcace480bddc3828953f4302668e8414506cd4ebf7cc4",
        samples: SAMPLES,
        iterations_per_sample: ITERATIONS,
        search_depth: SEARCH_DEPTH,
        search_profile: "Classical library default; deterministic 1-thread; LMR=on; SEE=on; NMP=on; cold 64MB TT per sample",
        search_reference_median_ns_per_node,
        representative_span: representative.reversible_span,
        representative_full_share: representative.full_share_of_search_node,
        representative_non_board_excess_share: representative.non_board_excess_share_of_search_node,
        representative_history_scan_share: representative.history_scan_share_of_search_node,
        classification,
        span_rows,
        search_rows,
    };

    println!(
        "TE1_SEARCH_POSITION_HOTPATH_SUMMARY {}",
        serde_json::to_string(&summary).expect("summary serialization must succeed")
    );
}
